# @three-ws/witness

> Turn a real user session into a runnable failing test. A tiny, privacy-first session recorder that captures intent (not pixels, not DOM mutations) and compiles it into a Playwright spec that stays red until the reported bug is fixed.

@three-ws/witness is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/witness`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-witness/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-witness/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-witness/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-witness/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
